description: This file serves as an entry point for running a Flask web application. It imports the app instance from the 'app' module and defines a 'run' function that starts the Flask server, binding to all network interfaces on a port specified by the environment variable 'PORT' or defaulting to 3001. When executed directly, it calls the 'run' function to start the server.

methods.name: run()
methods.description: Starts the Flask application server, binding to host 0.0.0.0 and using the port number from the 'PORT' environment variable, defaulting to 3001. The server runs with threading enabled for improved responsiveness.
